exact.有限離散格子 → 分類；本例拉麵/滷肉飯、資工/電機皆為離散標籤。: Finite discrete boxes → classification; in this example, ramen/braised pork rice and CS/EE are both discrete labels.
exact.$s=4.5+5=9.5$：回歸直接輸出 $9.5\\in\\mathbb{R}: $s=4.5+5=9.5$: regression outputs $9.5\in\mathbb{R}$ directly; classification applies $s\ge0\to\ell_2$, so $ell_2$.
exact.分類用 $x_1+x_2=0$ 虛線硬切平面；回歸同一批點只按分數上色，無硬切。: Classification uses the dashed line $x_1+x_2=0$ to hard-cut the plane; regression just colors the same points by score, with no hard cut.

29f6aa655bf1.zh: 什麼叫「監督」？What is Supervised Learning?

b46e46aafb99.zh: 大一新生需要學長姐指路：哪裡是陷阱、哪裡是捷徑。機器也一樣，需要「帶標籤的老師（資料集）」。Freshmen need seniors; models need labeled teachers.
b46e46aafb99.en: College freshmen need upperclassmen to show them the way: where the traps are and where the shortcuts are. Machines are the same: they need a “teacher with labels” (a dataset).

44f97339180c.zh: 監督式學習 = 用「輸入 $x_i$ + 正確答案標籤 $y_i$」成對餵養，讓 $f_\theta$ 學會「看到新輸入就答對」。Learn from input–label pairs to answer unseen inputs.
44f97339180c.en: Supervised learning = feeding the model pairs of “input $x_i$ + correct answer label $y_i$” so that $f_\theta$ learns to “get it right when it sees a new input”.

a61aff6acad1.zh: 沒有標籤的隨機照片堆，不會讓電腦頓悟；有標籤的 5 碗拉麵 + 5 碗滷肉飯才會。Random pile ≠ learning; labeled examples do.
a61aff6acad1.en: A random pile of unlabeled photos won't give the computer an epiphany; 5 labeled bowls of ramen + 5 labeled bowls of braised pork rice will.

c3210e4112c5.zh: 盔甲 $\mathcal{R}^d$、$\ell_1$、$f_\theta$ 只是記號；骨子裡是「老師指著答案教你」。Notation is armor; essence is teacher pointing at answer.
c3210e4112c5.en: The armor of $\mathcal{R}^d$, $\ell_1$, and $f_\theta$ is just notation; at its core, it's “a teacher pointing at the answer and teaching you”.

9cc9a0124b4f.en: Classification: Teaching a Computer to Recognize Ramen vs. Braised Pork Rice

655c52c13278.zh: 把每個東西分到預先定義好的、有限的「離散格子」裡。Map input to one of $k$ discrete boxes.
655c52c13278.en: Assign each item to one of a predefined, finite set of $k$ “discrete boxes”.

4fc0717609bd.zh: 例：$\{\text{蘋果, 黃瓜, 拉麵, 滷肉飯}\}$、$\{\text{資工, 電機}\}$。E.g. {apple, cucumber, ramen, braised pork}.
4fc0717609bd.en: E.g. $\{\text{apple, cucumber, ramen, braised pork rice}\}$, $\{\text{CS, EE}\}$.

9eef8e3a848a.zh: 收集 5 碗標記「拉麵」、5 碗標記「滷肉飯」，指著說「這是拉麵、這是滷肉飯」，讓電腦從「有沒有湯、碗形、鋪料」等特徵 (Features)學心法 $f_\theta$。Show 5+5 labeled bowls; model learns features → rule.
9eef8e3a848a.en: Collect 5 bowls labeled “ramen” and 5 bowls labeled “braised pork rice”, point at them and say “this is ramen, this is braised pork rice”, and let the computer learn the rule $f_\theta$ from features such as “is there soup, the bowl shape, the toppings”.

74b640bff980.en: Predict a “continuous” real value from the features: $y_i \in \mathbb{R}$ (e.g., a score of $78.5$).

6e1a3c655ba6.zh: 每週讀書時數、缺課堂數、打電動時數Study hrs, absences, gaming hrs.

c54c34830717.en: Any real number from 0 to 100 (78.5), not a finite set of boxes

aec4bf05de3c.zh: 電腦學會「讀書時數↔分數」連結，新學期狀態丟進去就吐出預測分數。Model links features to score; new input → predicted value.
aec4bf05de3c.en: The computer learns the “study hours ↔ score” link; feed in a new semester's situation and it spits out a predicted score.
